classes.name: Fanged Deserter
classes.description: You have thirty or so friends who never let you down: YOUR TEETH. Disloyal, deranged or simply uncontrollable.
classes.specialAttack: Bite attack: DR10 to attack, d6 damage. Must be close. 1-2 on d6 chance enemy gets a free attack.

origins.text: A burnt-black building in Sarkash. Your home?
A derelict rotting ship rolling endlessly across a grey sea.
A brothel in Schleswig. Quite a friendly environment.
Sleeping with dogs in the corner of an inn, waiting for someone to return.
Following an army in eastern Wästland.
Suckling a wolf in the wild of Bergen Chrypt.

features.name: Crumpled Monster Mask
features.description: Strikes primitive fear into lesser creatures like goblins, gnoums and children. While worn, they check Morale every round.

features.name: The Brown Scimitar of Galgenbeck
features.description: A stinking sword pulled from a military shit-ditch. d6 damage. DR10 attack and defence while wielded. 1 in 6 chance a wounded enemy is smitten with potent sepsis, dying in 10 minutes.

features.name: Wizard Teeth
features.description: Four weird teeth rattle within a blackened pouch. Before battle roll a d6 for each one. For every 6 one of your attacks deals maximum damage.

features.name: Old Sigûrd's Sling
features.description: Woven from long grey hair, 2d4 damage, requires fist-sized rocks which are everywhere.

features.name: Ancient Gore-Hound
features.description: Asthmatic, deluded, superb nose to sniffle up treasure. Attacks DR10 (bite d6), Defends DR12, 10 HP. Frenzied around goblins and berserkers.

features.name: The Shoe of Death's Horse
features.description: Hits with DR10, d4 damage. 1 in 6 chance the shoe smashes the skull, instantly killing small-to-medium creatures. Returns to your hand like a boomerang.

classes.name: Gutterborn Scum
classes.description: An ill star smiled upon your birth. Poverty, crime and bad parenting didn't help either.
classes.specialAttack: Stealthy: all Presence and Agility tests have their DR reduced by 2 (normal tests are DR10 instead of DR12).

origins.text: Dumped onto a moving shit-cart still in your birth caul.
Mother hanged from a tree outside of Galgenbeck, you fell from the corpse.
Raised by rats in the gutters of Grift.
Kicked and beaten beneath a baker's table in Schleswig.
Escaped the Tvelandian orphanarium.
Educated by outlaws in a hovel south of Alliáns.

features.name: Coward's Jab
features.description: When attacking by surprise test Agility DR10. On success automatically hit once with a light one-handed weapon, dealing normal damage +3.

features.name: Filthy Fingersmith
features.description: Pick pockets and pick locks with a DR8 Agility test. Also begins with lockpicks.

features.name: Abominable Gob Lobber
features.description: Spit d2 times during a fight. DR8 Presence for accuracy. Targets blinded, retching and vomiting d4 rounds. Witnesses test Toughness (PCs DR10, enemies DR12) or also vomit.

features.name: Escaping Fate
features.description: Every time you use an Omen there is a 50% chance it is not spent.

features.name: Excretal Stealth
features.description: Hide in muck, debris and filth; a DR16 Presence test is required to notice you.

features.name: Dodging Death
features.description: On death, if there is even the slightest possibility you survived, 50% chance you pop back up after 10 rounds with d4 HP.

classes.name: Esoteric Hermit
classes.description: The stone of your cave is one with the stars. Silence and perfection, now disturbed by a fallen world.
classes.specialAttack: Begins with one random scroll (sacred or unclean).

origins.text: Awakening, adult, in a ritual circle underneath the northern bridge to Grift.
Wandered, memoryless, from the mouth of a cavern at the cliffs of Terion.
Single child survivor of an incident in the Valley of the Unfortunate Undead.
Dying of plague in a Bergen Chrypt hovel, you touched something from outside.
An average individual until you encountered something in a dim glade in Sarkash.
Raised on a lonely island in Lake Onda. No one else has ever heard of it.

features.name: Master of Fate
features.description: What use are maps when causality is open to you? You know the right way with a DR8 Presence test.

features.name: Book of Boiling Blood
features.description: Once a day open and read. Enemy tests DR12 to prevent; on fail d2 Berserker-slayers appear (1-4 ally, 5-6 attack you).

features.name: Speaker of Truths
features.description: Twice per day use your wisdom to lower the DR of a creature's next test by 4.

features.name: Initiate of the Invisible College
features.description: Once per day summon d2 single-use scrolls (d4: 1-2 sacred, 3-4 unclean). Turn to ash at sunrise if unused.

features.name: Bard of the Undying
features.description: The music of your Harp gives +d4 on reaction rolls.

features.name: Hawk as Weapon
features.description: Crafty loyal hawk keeps watch, scouts, and swoops. Attacks/defence DR10 (claws/bite d4), HP 8.

classes.name: Wretched Royalty
classes.description: Bowed down only by the memories of your own lost glory, you could never submit to anyone else.
classes.specialAttack: Painfully average, adjust no abilities. Reroll if heavy armor is rolled.
classes.originsTitle: Things were going so well, until...

origins.text: Your Wästland palace was reduced to rubble.
Your caravan kingdom of Tveland fell into penury.
King Fathmu IX's brother Zigmund, your father, was murdered.
The southern empire of Südglans sank into the sea.
Anthelia demanded a gift of noble blood.
Two young princes were kidnapped west of Bergen Chrypt.

features.name: The Blade of your Ancestors
features.description: Foppish magical talking sword that despises you. Deals d6+1 damage, Attack/Defence DR10. 1 in 6 chance to 'accidentally' attack you or companions if disappointed.

features.name: 'Poltroon' the Court Jester
features.description: Capering makes enemies lose focus. For the first two rounds of combat you and allies get +2 on attack/defence.

features.name: Barbarister the Incredible Horse
features.description: Magical, arrogant, talking horse. Adds +2 to Presence tests involving logic and intellect if persuaded.

features.name: Hamfund the Squire
features.description: Cowardly guardian of the cursed sword Eurekia (2d6 damage). Roll d6 per swing; on 1 squire is slain and Eurekia vanishes forever.

features.name: The Snake-Skin Gift
features.description: Sandalwood box with a dagger (d4 damage); on a 1 (on damage or roll) target dies immediately of deadly poison.

features.name: Horn of the Schleswig Lords!
features.description: Once per day test Presence DR12 to grant one creature automatic success on their next non-combat test.

classes.name: Heretical Priest
classes.description: Hunted by the Two-Headed Basilisks of the One True Faith, raving in ruins and desecrating cathedrals by night.
classes.specialAttack: May use Powers while wearing medium armor.

origins.text: Galgenbeck, near the cathedral of the Two-Headed Basilisks.
Massacred Alliáns cult, sole survivor.
The crypts of Grift.
Temple ruins in the Valley of the Unfortunate Undead.
One of the many Graven-Tosk thief-tunnels.
Secret Bergen Chrypt church.

features.name: Sacred Shepherd's Crook
features.description: Human bone hook inscribed with anti-prayers. Staff does 2d4 damage except to faithless humans.

features.name: Stolen Mitre
features.description: While worn, Defence DR10. Pulled over ears outside battle, nearly invisible (stealth DR8).

features.name: List of Sins
features.description: Presence DR10 surrounds evil creatures in strange light; owner defends with +2 against them.

features.name: The Blasphemous Nechrubel Bible
features.description: Peruse once per day and roll a die. Even: PCs heal d4 HP after 5 min rest all day. Odd: d3 demonic hallucinations until sunrise.

features.name: Stones from Thel-Emas' Lost Temple
features.description: Cast stones to reveal danger in adjacent room. Test Presence DR10 to see if they are true.

features.name: (Wrong Jesus) Crucifix
features.description: Check morale (modified by Presence) against undead, lesser trolls, and goblins to make them bow and leave.

classes.name: Occult Herbmaster
classes.description: Born of the mushroom, raised in the glade, watched by the eye of the moon in a silverblack pool.
classes.specialAttack: Carries a portable laboratory. Daily brews two random decoctions (d4 total doses, expire after 24h).

origins.text: Calm isolation in the Sarkash dark.
The illegal midnight markets of Schleswig.
The heretic isle of Crëlut, two nautical miles east of Grift.
The old frozen ruins not far from Alliáns.
A little witches cottage in Galgenbeck.
The ruins of the Shadow King's manse, thick with memories of mushrooms and smoke.

herbmasterDecoctions.name: Ezumiels Vapor
herbmasterDecoctions.effect: Pass a DR14 test or severe (and arguably fun) hallucinations for d4 hours.

herbmasterDecoctions.name: Southern Frog Stew
herbmasterDecoctions.effect: Vomit for d4 hours; pass a DR14 test or you can do nothing else.

herbmasterDecoctions.name: Elixir Vitalis
herbmasterDecoctions.effect: Heals d6 HP and stops infection. Can be habit-forming.

herbmasterDecoctions.name: Spider-Owl Soup
herbmasterDecoctions.effect: See in darkness, climb on walls for 30 minutes.

herbmasterDecoctions.name: Fernor's Philtre
herbmasterDecoctions.effect: Translucent oil, dabbed into the eye. Heals infection and gives +2 on Presence tests for d4 hours.

herbmasterDecoctions.name: Hyphos' Enervating Snuff
herbmasterDecoctions.effect: Berserk! Two attacks per round but defend with DR14. Lasts one fight. Causes sneezing.

herbmasterDecoctions.name: Black Poison
herbmasterDecoctions.effect: Toughness DR14 or -d6 HP and blinded for one hour.
